text: What to do if your girlfriend insults you? Or as the author of the story puts it, uses hurtful words. Let's go straight to the message. Hello, I'm writing to ask for advice on my relationship that makes me worry non-stop and overthink things. That doesn't even happen. And one of the factors of why I overthink is that my girlfriend sometimes uses hurtful words without meaning it. We both apologize to each other and the cycle repeats. First of all, man, don't be naive. If she uses hurtful words repeatedly, she means them. You can tell her once not to do it, but if she repeats, it means she actually wants her words to hurt you. Before that, we have actually been together twice. She asked me for a breakup twice, more like it. But I'm a very anxious, attached guy. And I know she complained that her life is a mess. And I did my best to understand her by studying psychology and trying to understand her feelings. She felt grateful to have someone like me that actually really cares about her and understands her more than anyone even in her own family. So you broke up twice, got together again, and she felt grateful to have someone like you. Translation, she broke up with you, tried to find someone better, didn't succeed for whatever reason, maybe the good guys actually didn't want a girl like her, and came back to a loser who is waiting for her studying psychology to boost her self-esteem. Guys, one more time, if you broke up and it doesn't matter who initiated it, you do not get back together. Now I want to talk about the main problem or the reason I'm actually writing this. Sometimes my girlfriend wants to do things that I feel uncomfortable when she does it. And yes, we have actually calmed down and talked to each other with it. But the cycle repeats. Yeah man, and the cycle will keep repeating because she doesn't love you, she doesn't respect you, she doesn't care about you. By the way guys, you can DM me your relationship stories slash questions. I used to write answers directly in the DMs, but since the channel is growing, it is tougher to do so. So if I find your story interesting enough for a video, I most probably break it down directly on the channel, similar to this message. Otherwise you can sign up for a one-on-one consultation. To put it simply, just yesterday she wants to go out at night with her friends, even though she has promised me before she won't go out at night anymore. This of course worries me, because it is very dangerous for her to go out outside, especially the area she is in, the one of the most dangerous area with crimes happening every day. I tried to talk to her about this yesterday and she ends up shutting me down in a very harsh and hurtful words. Man, at this point you should have broken up with her a long time ago. Block her and let her do whatever she wants. Even if she wants to go to Epstein Island, you shouldn't care. Later we both discuss about this after I told her how much I overthink and think of things that might happen even though it didn't. Still to me there's a slight possibility bad things might happen to her if she continues to go out at night. I tried to tell her she could go out anytime she wants, but not night time. But she ends up saying it is the same and shutting me down before I could explain anything. Every time you try to talk to her but she does things that hurt you, you disrespect yourself more and more. And how can you expect her to respect you if you do not respect yourself, man? One of the hardest things in my relationship, I think, is that I am an anxious attachment and she is avoidant attachment. We are also currently on a long distance relationship, so when I try to explain things, she feels the pressure and immediately retreats. In other words, shutting me down. Even though we both discuss it and apologize to each other, the cycle still repeats. One of the hardest thing is that you are a little doofus when it comes to relationship. You have no boundaries and you need to start working on yourself instead of reading those psychology books. Anxious attachment, avoidant attachment. I need your advice to fix this issue permanently with my girlfriend or at least make it happen less. Because in the end, we end up hurting each other with our words. Thank you for reading this and I hope you can really give me some advices and I will try my best to fix things with her. Man, you can't fix relationship like this. You need to find the right person for relationship in the first place. But in your current state, even if you meet a girl who would be good for relationship, you yourself cannot live up to that standard. You have a ton of work ahead of you. If you want to be a decent man, start with loving yourself, respecting yourself, and having boundaries. Then work on other aspects of your life. Hope that helps. Thanks a lot. My name is Ilyas Abdullin and bye.
